claims.text: EMS dispatched 2024-01-08 at 12:45 to NSK plant for industrial machinery entrapment involving Davis, age 28
Left arm crushed by metal stamping press
Tourniquet applied by factory responder, IV Fentanyl 100mcg given, transported to Midwest Regional
Admitted emergently to ICU-04 at 13:25 with diagnosis of complete traumatic amputation between shoulder and elbow, left arm (S48.112A), attending Dr. Vance, admitting Dr. Cho
ED triage at 13:28, ESI Level 1, vitals BP 88/50, HR 130, RR 24, SpO2 93%, pain 10/10

Imaging showed comminuted open segmental fractures of forearm/hand, comminuted displaced supracondylar humerus fracture, complete cessation of brachial artery contrast enhancement, confirming unsalvageable limb
ED physician impression: mangled unsalvageable extremity with complete vascular/neurologic disruption and traumatic shock from blood loss and pain
Labs showed leukocytosis (WBC 14.2) and anemia (Hgb 8.9, Hct 27.2); UDS positive for trace cannabinoids, negative ethanol
Two units PRBC transfused before transfer to OR
Dr. Vance performed emergent left transhumeral amputation with myofascial closure, bone beveling, traction-neurectomy of median/ulnar/radial nerves; EBL 650mL; JP drain placed
JP drain removed on postoperative day 4, January 12

Prosthetic rehab delayed when Liberty Mutual placed authorization on hold pending peer review (Dec 15, 2024), suspending therapy
Formal PT resumed January 12, 2025
